prompt: micronaut openapi multiple spec files UI frameworks support
answer:
Micronaut supports merging multiple OpenAPI YAML files into a final specification.

For displaying multiple separate spec files:

| UI framework | Multiple spec files |
|---|---|
| Swagger UI | Supported out of the box |
| Scalar | Supported out of the box |
| RapiDoc | Not supported directly; complete the template yourself |
| ReDoc | Not supported directly; complete the template yourself |
| OpenAPI Explorer | Not supported directly; complete the template yourself |

Micronaut can also generate multiple UI views in one application. Earlier documentation lists Swagger UI, ReDoc, and RapiDoc as supported UI frameworks; newer documentation additionally lists Scalar and OpenAPI Explorer. (Micronaut OpenAPI documentation: https://docs.micronaut.io/5.1.x/openapi)
